records.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.125.0. When enabled, reconstructs full 128-bit TraceIDs for spans coming from Datadog instrumented services so they correlate with OpenTelemetry spans. Enabled by default; disable to fall back to 64-bit (zero-padded) TraceIDs.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.datadogreceiver.EnableMultiTagParsing · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.142.0. When enabled, parses `key:value` tags with duplicate keys into a slice attribute.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.githubreceiver.UseCheckRunID · main
records.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.151.0. When enabled, deterministic job, step, and queue span IDs are derived from the GitHub check_run_id (the WorkflowJob.id webhook field, also exposed in-runner as ${{ job.check_run_id }}). Step span IDs additionally incorporate the step's raw name, allowing in-action telemetry tools to reproduce matching span IDs without calling the GitHub REST API and without knowing the runner-dependent step number. Payloads missing a check_run_id are rejected while this gate is enabled. Workflows with duplicate step names within a job will log a warning; duplicate steps will share the same span ID.

records.title: OTel feature gate: hostmetrics.process.bootTimeCache · main
records.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.98.0. When enabled, all process scrapes will use the boot time value that is cached at the start of the process.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetrics.DontEmitV0SystemConventions · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, all scrapers stop emitting legacy semantic convention metrics, superseding per-scraper gates.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetrics.EmitV1SystemConventions · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.160.0. When enabled, all scrapers emit metrics aligned with the latest semantic conventions, superseding per-scraper gates.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.hostmetricsreceiver.UseLinuxMemAvailable · main
records.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.137.0. When enabled, the used value for the system.memory.usage and system.memory.utilization metrics will be based on the Linux kernel's MemAvailable statistic instead of MemFree, Buffers, and Cached.

records.title: OTel feature gate: scraper.process.DontEmitV0SystemConventions · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv legacy attributes are disabled.

records.title: OTel feature gate: scraper.process.EmitV1SystemConventions · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.158.0. When enabled, semconv stable attributes are enabled.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.k8sobjects.useInformerObserver · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.164.0. When enabled, the receiver collects objects via a shared informer factory (List+Watch backed by an in-memory cache) instead of the legacy per-object pull/watch observers. Pull mode reads from the informer cache; watch mode uses informer event handlers with automatic relist/reconnect. The `pull` RBAC now also requires the `watch` verb, `resource_version` is ignored, and `exclude_watch_type: [BOOKMARK, ERROR]` is a no-op.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.kubeletstats.cpuUsageScrapeBased · main
records.summary: BETA gate; introduced v0.156.0. When enabled, container.cpu.usage, k8s.pod.cpu.usage and k8s.node.cpu.usage (and the cpu utilization metrics derived from them) are calculated by the receiver as the rate of the corresponding *.cpu.time counter between consecutive scrapes, instead of being read directly from the kubelet's UsageNanoCores value.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.prometheus.UseTargetUrlForServerAddress · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.165.0. When enabled, server.address, server.port, and url.scheme are populated from the scraped target's post-relabeling __address__ and __scheme__ labels instead of parsing the instance label and pre-relabeling service discovery labels.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.prometheusreceiver.EnableCreatedTimestampZeroIngestion · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.113.0. Enables the Prometheus created-timestamps-zero-injection feature. Created timestamps are injected as 0-valued samples when appropriate. This is disabled by default due to worse CPU performance with higher metric volumes.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.postgresql.separateSchemaAttr · main

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.postgresql.useOTelSemconv · main

When disabled, uses the legacy per-entity resource model with postgresql.database.name, postgresql.table.name, postgresql.index.name, and postgresql.schema.name resource attributes.

records.title: OTel feature gate: receiver.statsd.monotonicCounterDefault · main
records.summary: ALPHA gate; introduced v0.159.0. When enabled, changes the default value of is_monotonic_counter to true, so that statsd counters are treated as monotonic sums by default.
